description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git commit notes organization and management using various techniques such as fanout directories, concatenation, and note verification. It includes test setup, functions for creating commits and notes, and multiple test cases employing git fast-import, rev-list, and grep commands.

methods.name: start_note_commit
methods.description: Initializes a commit that adds or updates notes in refs/notes/commits.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that notes in the commit log match expected format for a certain number of commits.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and compares output.

methods.name: test_sha1_based
methods.description: Creates notes based on SHA1 hashes with specific path transformations.

methods.name: test_same_notes
methods.description: Creates commits where multiple note paths reference the same note content.

methods.name: test_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Creates commits with multiple notes concatenated in a specific order.

methods.name: verify_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Verifies concatenated notes in commit logs.
